authorization: existing subscription only; no API spend, credits or purchases
runtime: native collaboration subagents; CLI/App Server startup blocked
speed: not selectable; tool advertises priority service tier
context: fork_turns=none; exact task prompt; platform instructions remain; no worker reasoning to E-only
allocation: 2 technical probes; 2 identical batch baselines; at most 1 W evidence-backed repair and 1 E takeover after W failure

policies.W-only: initial W; at most one repair of failed tasks with objective counterevidence
policies.E-only: initial E; no repair allocated in this narrowed pilot
policies.W-to-E: reuse exact initial W checkpoint; if checks fail, one fresh E takeover on failed tasks

stopping: cancel at time limit; do not exceed six starts; stop on unauthorized tools/files or billing uncertainty requiring new payments
acceptance: exact predetermined JSON outputs checked by local deterministic verifier; reject missing, extra or malformed fields; audit every result
measurements: requested model/effort, tool acknowledgment, observed wall-time interval, exact prompt and answer, checker results, all failures; actual quota, tokens, billed cost unknown unless exposed
limits: synthetic answer-only microtasks; no filesystem isolation claim, no start/resume/fork/interruption certification, no economic conclusion; paired W checkpoint reused and charged logically in each policy
